archetype: ARCHETYPE 1: ORGANIC & EARTHY mixed with SWISS HIGH-CONTRAST (Light, Airy, Tech-Forward)
design_direction: Must look distinctly different from Freshdesk/Freshchat. Airy, modern, zero dark bloat, cardless or ultra-soft borderless sections, glass-misming ambient light, high micro-interaction fluidity, and high-visibility AI indicators.

grids_and_layout.spacing: Generous spacing. p-6, p-8, p-12 with max-w-7xl containers.
grids_and_layout.sidebar: Slim floating navigational pillar with backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-r border-slate-200/60
grids_and_layout.bento_insights: Asymmetric Bento Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6) for Training Insights & AI Metrics
grids_and_layout.live_chat_layout: 3-Column Fluid Canvas: [Customer Simulator & Context] | [Fayr Assistant Live AI Stream & Agent Takeover] | [Continuous Learning & Memory Inspector]

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all JS files use modern React functional patterns.
Do not use dark backgrounds for main containers. Stick to clean light-mode palettes with soft indigo/emerald/amber ambient accents.
Every key interactive element must have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.
Build the 5 core views: AI Live Chat Console, AI Email Inbox, Knowledge Base Manager, Canned Responses Manager, and Training Insights Dashboard.
Highlight Claude Sonnet 4.6 as the underlying intelligence engine.
Ensure the Handoff Banner activates clearly with 3 triggers: user request, low confidence (<70%), or user frustration sentiment.
Provide live learning indicators showing captured human replies instantly feeding into AI memory.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: DO NOT use generic centered layouts or heavy dark gradients.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (backdrop-blur-md) for floating headers, tooltips, and status banners.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition: all. Specify precise transition parameters (e.g. transition: opacity 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease).
Never center align main page containers (.App { text-align: center }). Keep standard left/grid alignments.
Include data-testid on buttons, inputs, links, tabs, badges, and modals.
